biggest_catch: Cashback is a rebate on spending, not income or guaranteed earnings — and if you go 12 straight months without earning cash back, a $1.99/month maintenance fee eats your balance (closing your account forfeits everything).
catches: Cashback is a rebate on spending, not income or guaranteed earnings — rates and merchants change.
$10 minimum available cash back (excluding bonuses) to cash out; first cashout must include a rebate order.
After 12 months without cash back earnings, a $1.99 monthly maintenance fee applies until the balance hits $0 or you earn again; zero-balance accounts may be closed.
Account closure forfeits all cash back; program termination gives a 60-day redemption window.
Ad blockers and coupon codes outside RebatesMe can void tracking — shop with them disabled on purchase runs.
Third-party reviews cite a $30 redemption minimum and a $4.99/month fee, which conflict with the official terms above — the official terms govern.

steps: Create a free account at https://www.rebatesme.com/ and install the extension if offered.
Find your store and click the Shop Now button to activate cashback tracking.
Make your purchase as normal in the same session — disable ad blockers and do not apply outside coupon codes.
Wait for the order to sync and confirm — cash back becomes available after the 90-day return window.
Earn at least once every 12 months to avoid the $1.99/month maintenance fee.
Once you have $10+ in available cash back (excluding bonuses), request a cashout.
Choose PayPal, credit card deposit, Alipay, check, or gift cards and follow the payout prompts.
timing: Cash back becomes available after the 90-day return window; processing 1–5 business days after confirmation. Minimum $10 available cash back (excluding bonuses).
